jobs.title: Senior Data Analytics Implementation Specialist
jobs.description_text: Sobre a função: Estamos à procura de uma pessoa para a função de Especialista Sénior em Data Analytics Implementation (m/f/d) para assumir a liderança técnica de projetos de arquitetura e medição de dados digitais. Nesta função, serás uma das principais referências técnicas da área, guiando projetos complexos do início ao fim: desde a fundação técnica (Data Layer, GTM, Server-Side, RGPD) até à otimização do negócio, atribuição e medição omnicanal. O teu foco principal será o ecossistema GA4 (Web e Apps), enriquecendo a medição com fontes omnicanal e dados de negócio. Uma parte central do trabalho consiste em compreender o impacto da media nestes dados e gerar insights acionáveis para as equipas de media otimizarem a sua performance. É fundamental ter conhecimentos em atribuição digital e no cruzamento de dados de GA4 com modelos de MMM (Marketing Mix Modeling). Responsabilidades Principais: Estratégia & Plano de Medição: Definir e manter o Plano de Medição (Measurement Plan), matrizes de KPIs e a arquitetura de dados das nossas plataformas digitais (Web e App). Garantir a consistência e padronização da taxonomia de dados, parametrização de URLs (UTMs) e rastreio (tracking) entre canais de media e produto. Implementação & Gestão de Tags (Tag Management): Desenvolver, testar e homologar tags, pixels e eventos via Google Tag Manager (Web e Server-Side). Implementar e gerir integrações via API (ex.: Conversions API do Meta, Google Ads API, CDPs e MMPs). Análise de Dados, Atribuiç

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Eko Health builds devices and software that help clinicians detect heart and lung disease earlier. We’re looking for a Manager, Cost Accounting & Procure-to-Pay, remote in the US on Pacific hours, to own two things at the center of our business: what it costs us to put a device in a clinician’s hands, and how we pay for everything that gets it there.This is a build role. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, you will set Eko’s costing methodology and defend it to our auditors, own inventory valuation and reserves, run landed cost end to end, close COGS each month, and run procure-to-pay from purchase order to payment. You will partner with Supply Chain, Sales Operations, and FP&A, and your margin analysis will reach the executive team. You inherit a working foundation and a lot of room to make it better.A few things make this role unusual. Eko does not run a factory: devices are built by contract manufacturers and bought as finished goods, so cost is purchase price plus landed cost, and inventory sits with partners we cannot walk into. Hardware is sold alongside subscription software, so the margin story is blended. And this is a hands-on manager role with no direct reports to start: you provide review oversight to our offshore transactional team while personally owning the higher-judgment accounting, reconciliations, close, and conclusions. jobs.description_text: 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny 와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 13개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion에서 3D Design & Implementation Specialist를 채용합니다. [안내] 본 포지션은 패션 산업(브랜드, 벤더 등)에서 4-6년의 실무 경험을 갖춘 분들을 위한 채용입니다. CLO 소프트웨어의 기존 숙련도는 요구하지 않으며, 입사 후 새로운 IT 기술을 빠르게 습득하여 기존 패션 실무 지식과 결합할 수 있는 역량(Tech Savviness)을 중점적으로 평가합니다. CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 CLO 소프트웨어 전문가로서 패션/디자인/패턴에 관한 지식을 바탕으로 CLO 유저를 교육하고 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. 아울러, 유저의 니즈를 가장 먼저 이해하여 3D 프로세스가 효과적으로 접목될 수 있도록 전문적인 컨설팅을 진행합니다. 이처럼 CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 유저가 CLO를 더 효율적이고 가치있게 사용할 수 있도록 컨설팅, 교육, 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [CLO Software Test] → [2차 인터뷰 (+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] (1차 인터뷰 합격자에게는 2차 면접 전, CLO 사전 학습용 교육 자료 및 임시 라이선스가 제공됩니다. 2차 면접 시 진행되는 테스트는 기존의 CLO 숙련도가 아닌, 새로운 소프트웨어를 빠르게 습득하는 학습 능력과 패션 구조에 대한 이해도를 평가하기 위한 과정입니다.) To Apply 이력서 및 경력기술서 1부 (필수) 지원동기가 담긴 자기소개서 (필수) 본인의 담당 업무 및 참여 프로젝트가 기술된 포트폴리오 (선택) (CLO를 직접 다룬 경험이 없더라도, 참여하신 프로젝트 및 업무 경력을 확인하기 위해 포트폴리오 제출을 권장합니다.)

Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion의 글로벌 웹 기반 플랫폼과 서비스의 백엔드 개발에 참여할 동료를 모집합니다. 본 포지션은 CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠 관리 및 협업 플랫폼에 직접 참여하여, 고도화된 백엔드 서비스를 설계하고 구현하는 중요한 역할을 수행합니다. 플랫폼 서비스의 안정성과 확장성을 책임지는 백엔드 API 서버와 각종 Worker 서비스의 개발 및 구현을 담당하게 됩니다. 나아가 서비스 운영에 필수적인 검색 데이터 연동, 그리고 대용량 데이터 처리를 위한 다양한 백엔드 기술 통합을 경험하고 주도합니다. 최종적으로는 프론트엔드를 포함한 다양한 유관 부서와의 긴밀한 협업을 통해, 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 글로벌 플랫폼 서비스의 전반적인 기능을 설계하고 완성도 높은 제품을 만들어나갈 기회가 주어집니다. 기술 스택 (Tech Stack) Core: Kotlin/JAVA, Spring WebFlux/WebMVC, Coroutines Infra: Azure, AWS, K8s(optional), Docker AI Tools: Claude, Gemini Data: MS-SQL, Redis Monitoring: Datadog Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [과제 전형] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰(+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] *이력서를 제출하실 때 본인의 업무 이력과 역할, 그리고 그 과정에서 어떠한 부분을 느끼고 성장했는지 적어 주시면 좋습니다. *2차 인터뷰 조율 과정에서 레퍼런스 체크 요청을 드리고 있습니다. *각 전형에 대한 상세 안내는 메일을 통해 안내해 드리고 있습니다.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.description_text: CLO Virtual Fashion is redefining the future of apparel through cutting-edge 3D clothing simulation technology—powering the entire fashion lifecycle from concept and design to production, marketing, fitting, and styling. Since 2009, CLO has been building a dynamic digital fashion ecosystem, driven by its industry-leading simulation algorithms that blend the physical and virtual worlds of clothing. Position Overview Main responsibilities range from presenting the company's vision and products to potential clients, spearheading the implementation and all processes related to it, partnering with the 3D Design & Implementation Team to ensure a successful training and onboarding, as well as analysis of client growth and expansion with clients in Europe and Africa.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Financial Institutions
jobs.description_text: Reporting to the Sales Director, you'll own a named account list with some of the country's largest banks and credit unions. These institutions know who we are as Greenlight is the market leader in a rapidly growing youth and family banking category. Many have been in conversation with us. What they need is someone who can reach the executives who own the P&L, build the business case in their numbers, and drive a seven-figure agreement to signature. You're also not starting from a blank page. We’ve spent 4 years building the enterprise playbook: the positioning, the business case, the deal motion. You'll run it, pressure-test it, and help shape where it goes next.

jobs.title: Senior Content Creator
jobs.description_text: Greenlight is looking for a Senior Content Creator who is, first and foremost, a creator. Someone who can spot a trend in the morning, be on camera by lunch, and have it posted before the moment passes and who also knows how to zoom out and build the strategy that makes those posts add up to growth. This is a hybrid creator-strategist role. You'll own Greenlight's organic social and influencer programs end to end: setting the strategy, writing the plan, and also making some content yourself. You're comfortable being the face in the videos, shooting on your phone, editing in-app, and getting something good out the door fast without a production crew. We're looking for someone with a real track record of growing accounts organically. If your best work came from scrappiness rather than spend, we want to see it.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Product Designer with a passion for creating great products for great people (in our case the modern family). In this role, you will partner closely with both our IDC office (Bangalore) and the US based design team members contributing to UX/UI direction helping ensure quality and consistency for our product & services. Working alongside partners from Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and other core teams, you will help ensure that Greenlight delivers truly lovable and memorable experiences. About the Team We are a collaborative, full-stack Design org with disciplines that span Product Design, Brand Design, Motion Design, Print Design, and Design Program Management. We are led by our VP of Design, Creative Director, and Product Design Director and work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing partners. Our team is critical in helping ensure that Greenlight delivers truly lovable experiences with product and brand expressions that are aligned.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to join our growing security team. This role will be critical in ensuring the security of our products across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) and provide support on different security initiatives. You will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed security best practices from design through to deployment. You will play a critical role in shaping our security posture, embedding security into our development lifecycle, and protecting our customers' data.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Strategic Finance Manager to collaborate with cross-functional leaders and drive outcomes across the business. In addition to traditional finance responsibilities of developing budgets, forecasts, and monthly/quarterly reports, this role will have significant involvement in new product analysis, data analytics, strategic projects, and company-wide planning. This position will report to the Finance Team Lead and collaborate with executives across all departments. We are looking for a true thought leader. A successful candidate should be self-motivated, hands-on, act as a proactive business partner and demonstrate the leadership capacity to assume increasing responsibility over time. This role is fast-paced and will have a direct impact on the company's ability to make key business decisions and grow efficiently.

jobs.description_text: GROUND NETWORK SPECIALIST (STARLINK) SpaceX is designing, building, and deploying the world’s largest network of ground station antennas – the Starlink gateways. Through our gateways, the Starlink satellite constellation is filling in the gaps in global connectivity. Want to help build the next era of Internet? We are looking for creative and driven field specialists to solve issues affecting sites and antenna availability. jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of space architecture concepts, sub-system design, payload design, requirements development, analysis and decomposition, high-level software and hardware system architecture design, concept of operations (CONOPS) development, and risk assessment. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success. The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content.

jobs.description_text: Own the State. Lead the Team. Drive the Growth. Are you a strategic sales leader with deep expertise in automotive finance and a passion for building high-performing teams? As a Sales Director you’ll be responsible for translating our national sales vision into localized strategy and execution. You’ll coach and develop your field team, guide territory expansion, and build strong dealer relationships to ensure consistent growth in contract volume and market share. Reporting to the Chief Sales Officer, you’ll serve as a key driver of Lendbuzz’s success in one of our most important markets. ***Residence within or near the assigned geographic territory is required.*** Compensation includes base salary, plus uncapped commission, and quarterly bonus structure based upon on your performance in hiring, retention, volume, and new business, providing an OTE of approximately $400,000.

jobs.title: Avionics Technician
jobs.description_text: LTA Research and Exploration, an aerospace start-up, is seeking an Avionics Technician specializing in systems integration on research and development flight vehicles. In order to help advance our goal of bringing revolutionary airships to life, the Avionics Technician will work directly with the appropriate company personnel to organize, plan, and execute the troubleshooting, installation, and inspections of various subsystems. This position will also provide flight operational support as required. The base range for this role is $45-62/hr, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Stress Analysis
jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a structures engineer with strong design and analysis fundamentals, someone eager to learn and flexible enough to take on whatever a fast-moving hardware program throws at them. You’ll work in an exciting, fast-paced environment tackling some of the most challenging structural problems in aerospace.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Safety Engineer (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA is seeking a Systems Safety Engineer to serve as a senior individual contributor and technical authority within the Systems Engineering function. Operating at the principal level, this engineer applies broad mastery across subsystems and disciplines beyond their core area to architect and validate new, complex system-of-systems and integration approaches where no legacy solution exists. The Principal Systems Engineer sets the overarching technical direction for a systems discipline, owns the system-level safety, verification, and certification strategy for a vehicle program or major system, and acts as a subject-matter expert during internal audits and regulatory interactions. This is a role for a proven technical leader who provides leadership and direction to multidisciplinary, integrated product teams, mentors and develops senior engineering staff, shapes program-defining architectures and drives the integration and certification of lighter-than-air flight vehicles. The base salary range for this role is $165,000 - 230,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications.
